sovereign_country.strategic_role: 全球海事商船注册旗国、借鉴特拉华州公司法的非公开发行实体

business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Bulk Export of Organic Dried Lycium and Herbal Botanicals

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Compact of Free Association between the Republic of the Marshall Islands and the United States of America (1986, as amended in 2003)
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) (2019)
Cotonou Partnership Agreement between the ACP Group and the European Union (2000, revised in Cotonou 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Republic of the Marshall Islands Revised Code 2018, Title 9 (Business Organizations and Business Corporation Act); Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2020 (as amended); RMI Financial Intelligence Unit AML/CFT Guidelines (2021); and the Registrar of Corporations Beneficial Ownership Disclosure Directive No. 1/2023.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified Copy of Passport of each shareholder and director
Certificate of Good Standing from country of incorporation (for corporate beneficial owners)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent corporate registry of the incorporating jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank Reference Letter confirming account relationship and UBO profile
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Issuing bank (signed by authorized banking officer)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association or draft constitutional documents (for corporate shareholders)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the RMI domestic sanctions list, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, and EU consolidated financial sanctions list. PEP screening is required for shareholders, directors, authorized signatories and ultimate beneficial owners, including family members and close associates. Enhanced due diligence and written source-of-funds analysis are mandatory for any PEP match. For Low_Risk_Standard dried goji berry wholesale, simplified due diligence is acceptable only when sanctions and PEP screening return no hits.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: RMI Corporate Registry Online Portal (administered through licensed registered agents under the Office of the Registrar of Corporations)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Corporate names must be submitted in English / Latin characters only. No foreign script, diacritics, Chinese characters, or non-Latin transliteration is permitted. Names must be pronounceable in English, distinguishable from existing registered names, and must include a statutory corporate suffix: 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Company', 'Limited' or an accepted abbreviation (Corp., Inc., Co., Ltd.).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon name rejection, the applicant or its licensed registered agent may file a written appeal with the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days of the rejection notice, attaching the rejection letter, a revised name (or grounds for contesting an incorrect rejection), and the administrative appeal fee. The Registrar shall respond in writing within 10 business days. If the appeal is denied, a further application may be made to the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands for review.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only as a supplementary administrative address for emails/communications. A physical registered office in the Marshall Islands, furnished by a licensed RMI registered agent, is mandatory; a P.O. Box alone is not accepted. The virtual office does not discharge the registered-office or commercial-substance obligations under the Business Corporation Act.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Estimated 25% probability of unannounced physical inspection of the registered office and records per regulatory cycle, based on risk-based AML/CFT supervision standards for a Low_Risk_Standard wholesale export entity.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Certificate of Incorporation Filing Fee (Non-Resident Business Corporation)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered Agent and Registered Office Service (First Year)
UBO Register Setup and AML/CFT Compliance Filing
PEP, OFAC, UN and Domestic Sanctions Screening (Beneficial Owners)
Notary Public and Hague Apostille / Consular Legalization Services
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary Public / Ministry of Foreign Affairs (RMI) or Consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff plus market notarial fee

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1987 (Marshall Islands), as amended; Articles of Incorporation requirements under Sections 7 and 8; first board resolution procedures under Section 44; Registered Agent and Registered Office requirements under Section 12.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Investment
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up or stated capital for a Marshall Islands non-resident Business Corporation; paid-up capital is determined by the Board; no escrow or capitalization deposit is required by the Registrar.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Board of Directors of the Corporation approves the subscription and issuance of the Company’s authorized common shares to the initial shareholder at par value or such other consideration approved by the Board; and FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office and registered agent designated in the Articles of Incorporation are adopted as the Corporation’s principal statutory address and statutory agent for all purposes; and FURTHER RESOLVED, that the officers named in the Board’s organizational minutes, including the President, Secretary, and Treasurer, are hereby appointed with such authority and duties as set forth by law and in the Bylaws; and FURTHER RESOLVED, that this resolution is effective as of the date of the first organizational meeting of the Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Reserve the Corporate Name and Verify Availability
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Marshall Islands Office of the Registrar of Corporations; online name search portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a corporate name reservation request through the Registrar's official portal or by written application. The proposed name must include a corporate suffix (e.g., 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or 'Ltd.') and must not be confusingly similar to an existing registered name. Payment of the name reservation fee is due at submission.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is rejected for similarity or prohibited character, file an administrative appeal with the Registrar within 10 business days, stating the distinguishing feature of the requested name, or submit an amended name reservation request.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Prepare and Submit Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands; online submission via the official registry system
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Duly execute the Articles of Incorporation by at least one incorporator, notarize the signature where required, and file the signed document together with the statutory filing fee. Include the corporation's name, initial registered agent and office address in the Marshall Islands, authorized share structure, and any opt-in provisions permitted by the Business Corporations Act.
required_dossiers: Certificate of name reservation or approved name
Consent to act as registered agent
Registered office address in the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or deficiency notice, the applicant may cure by filing a corrected Articles of Incorporation or a supplemental statement within 21 days of notice; failure to cure may result in withdrawal, but the applicant may re-file with new fees.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After the Registrar accepts the Articles of Incorporation and confirms the existence and authorized capital, the Registrar issues a stamped Certificate of Incorporation. Verify the certificate particulars, including the corporate name, file number, date of incorporation, and the statutory registered office and agent.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate contains clerical errors, submit a written application for correction accompanied by the original certificate; the Registrar may issue an amended certificate within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Direct the Registered Agent to Acknowledge Duties
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent approved by the Registrar of Corporations, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed registered agent in the Marshall Islands to maintain the statutory address, accept service of process, and provide the corporate office address required under the Business Corporations Act. Execute the registered agent consent form and ensure the agent’s name and address appear in the Articles of Incorporation.
required_dossiers: Name and physical address of the registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registered agent resigns or is disqualified, the Board must appoint a replacement agent and file a statement of change of registered agent with the Registrar within 30 days to avoid administrative suspension.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt Bylaws, Appoint Officers and File Initial Disclosure Statements
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors; Registrar of Corporations for subsequent annual disclosures
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first organizational meeting, adopt the corporate Bylaws, approve the first board resolution, elect officers, and authorize the issuance of shares. File the initial statement of officers and directors if required by the Registrar and retain the minutes of the organizational meeting in the corporate records book.
required_dossiers: Initial director and officer disclosure statement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects the disclosure statement due to incomplete officer data, file an amended statement within 15 days; late-filing penalties may be waived with a written explanation of inadvertent omission.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Marshall Islands Business Licensing Board, Ministry of Commerce, Trade and Investment
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: General Business License for Wholesale Distribution of Dried Botanicals and Herbal Food Products

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environmental Protection Authority of the Republic of the Marshall Islands
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: EPA Registration tier; full EIA report not required for a low-environmental-impact dried botanical wholesale and storage facility with no point-source industrial discharge, waste combustion, or chemical processing
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No unpermitted wastewater discharge to navigable waters; all stormwater and sanitary wastewater must be routed to approved collection systems. No volatile organic compound or particulate emissions from drying or packaging processes above the EPA minimum reporting thresholds; dried herbal waste must be disposed of in a manner consistent with EPA solid waste management standards and may not be burned on-site.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certification obtained from the Marshall Islands Fire Safety Office confirming approved extinguishing systems, emergency egress, and electrical safety; a structural load and shoring inspection certificate from the Ministry of Public Works; occupational safety and health clearance from the RMI Occupational Safety and Health Division covering warehouse handling, forklift operations, sanitation, and worker exposure to organic dust; and a certificate of occupancy issued by the Majuro local government for the licensed physical premises.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Finance, Treasury Division – Revenue and Tax Administration; Business License Office of the Ministry of Finance; Registrar of Corporations (Office of the Attorney General). No national taxpayer portal is operated; business license filings and corporation registrations are lodged through the RMI Business License / Registrar pipeline.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no income tax, VAT, or GST and issues no statutory TIN or VAT ID. A non-resident Business Corporation obtains legal personality by filing Articles of Incorporation with the Registrar of Corporations under the Business Corporations Act and thereafter obtains a Business License Certificate from the Business License Office solely for administrative and license-fee purposes. Export-only operations conducted wholly offshore require no fiscal registration or tax identification number.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: The RMI has no check-the-box, hybrid mismatch, or subpart F style election. Non-resident status is established de jure through the entity's certificate of non-residency filed with the Registrar of Corporations. A voluntary election to be treated as a resident business is possible by holding an RMI trading license and carrying on business within the RMI, which subjects the entity to the 3% Gross Revenue Tax on RMI-source gross revenue; no such election is recommended or required for the offshore export mandate.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: None – no VAT, GST, or sales and use tax regime exists. Indirect fiscal levies are limited to the 3% Gross Revenue Tax (GRT) on RMI-source business gross revenue, customs import duties under the Customs Tariff Act, and license-based fees. Export transactions are outside the scope of the GRT.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable – no VAT registration threshold exists in the RMI. Under the Gross Revenue Tax framework, a non-exempt entity becomes liable to obtain a Business License when it commences taxable business activity within the RMI; a non-resident exporter transacting exclusively offshore has zero RMI-source revenue and remains outside the licensing tax net regardless of turnover.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, API interconnectivity, digital stamping, SAF-T filing, or e-invoicing mandate exists. Commercial invoices and packing lists accompany customs export declarations lodged via ASYCUDA World through the RMI Customs Service, but no tax-administration electronic clearance or fiscal approval of invoices is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable – there is no VAT to zero-rate and no export refund mechanism to claim. A non-resident Business Corporation exporting dried goji berries and herbal botanicals is entirely exempt from indirect taxation provided no sale, delivery, or economic activity occurs within the RMI. The exemption flows from the entity's non-resident status rather than from a zero-rating certificate; goods consigned through RMI free-zone or port transit facilities do not lose this exempt character.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration lodged via ASYCUDA World through the RMI Customs Service
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing export movement
Phytosanitary Certificate issued under the Plant Quarantine Act for dried lycium and herbal botanicals
Certificate of Origin (self-certification or RMI Chamber of Commerce issuance)
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: No VAT clawback or fraudulent zero-rating penalty regime exists because the RMI levies no VAT on exports. False declaration of export status or abuse of non-resident tax classification is prosecuted under the Business Corporations Act and the Business License Act, exposing the entity to license revocation, corporate dissolution, fines up to USD 10,000 for corporation-register misconduct, and daily fines up to USD 5,000 for unlicensed RMI trading activity. If non-resident status is fraudulently claimed while trading inside the RMI, the 3% Gross Revenue Tax becomes retroactively assessable on RMI-source gross revenue, with statutory interest and penalty surcharges for underreporting; the RMI does not impose any separate exchange-control repatriation sanction.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banking Commission of the Republic of the Marshall Islands (Ministry of Finance), with no central bank or foreign-exchange administration; the U.S. Federal Reserve acts as the de facto monetary authority via official dollarization.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Capital and current account items are fully convertible. The official currency is the United States dollar, and the Republic of the Marshall Islands imposes no domestic capital controls, no currency rationing, and no restriction on profit remittance. Because no local currency exists, convertibility is effectively the same as USD convertibility in international markets; the only practical frictions arise from bank-level AML/KYC diligence and OFAC/sanctions screening by correspondent banks.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation exists. Export receipts are not subject to mandatory conversion ratios, forced timelines, or repatriation limits. The company may retain proceeds in USD or any freely convertible foreign currency, and may manage settlements through its own treasury without central bank approval.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Medium conditional. Regulated offshore EMIs may accept an RMI Business Corporation only when the corporate secretary is an RMI-licensed registered agent and the company provides transactional evidence such as invoices, bills of lading, and phytosanitary certificates. Major U.S.-centric digital banks generally do not open accounts for RMI-domiciled entities because the RMI is not an EEA or U.S. domestic jurisdiction; global EMIs may escalate due to the herbal/botanical product classification. Legal constraints include sanctions screening, prohibited-business list review, and enhanced beneficial-ownership disclosure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For Bank of Marshall Islands, in-person attendance at a Majuro branch by at least one director or authorized signatory is mandatory unless the account is opened through an accredited RMI registered agent using remote video verification. Bank of Guam will permit remote initiation but requires full U.S. BSA/AML documentation and a relationship-officer interview. No fully anonymous or non-interview remote opening is available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident exempt corporation with no physical staff or office in RMI.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: RMI Certificate of Good Standing and certified Charter; registered-agent agreement; full ownership diagram; audited financial statements; evidence of physical warehouse and staff in the origin/export country; board resolution designating the operative office.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Botanical/herbal trade flagged as a possible controlled supplement or unapproved medicinal product.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory wholesale license under ISIC 4631; phytosanitary certificate from country of origin; laboratory analytical report demonstrating food-grade dried Lycium without pharmacological claims; Certificate of Origin; supplier GMP/ISO certificate; commercial invoices referencing the exact declared tariff line and tariff classification opinion from the importing jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-frequency invoicing to PRC counterparties in CNY with possible transshipment patterns.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Particularized purchase contracts; warehouse custody receipts; Bills of Lading or airway bills; customs export declarations; cargo inspection reports; beneficial-ownership declarations for each counterparty; a detailed trade-flow narrative matching invoices to physical movement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from shareholders located in offshore or financial secrecy jurisdictions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Shareholder bank statements evidencing source of funds; tax identification numbers; source-of-wealth questionnaire; board-minuted capital contribution; proof that funds came through regulated banking channels; no-corruption declaration and beneficial-owner statement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Because the RMI is dollarized and has no exchange controls, inbound shareholder capital is wired in USD via SWIFT MT103 to the company's account at a U.S. correspondent bank using Fedwire/CHIPS settlement. The MT103 field 70 should state 'CAPITAL CONTRIBUTION', with ISO 20022 purpose code 'EQUI' where supported. The receiving bank will require a certified board resolution authorizing the injection, an ownership certificate, and source-of-funds documentation; all wires are screened against OFAC and United Nations sanctions lists.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements are executed primarily through (i) SWIFT MT103 USD wire transfers using the U.S. clearing system, or (ii) irrevocable Commercial Letters of Credit issued or confirmed under UCP 600. For LCs, issuance is communicated via SWIFT MT700 and requires documents including commercial invoice, full-set ocean Bill of Lading or airway bill, packing list, insurance certificate, phytosanitary certificate, and inspection certificate. Because the company is primarily USD-denominated, any CNY or EUR supplier invoice requires an FX conversion through an approved spot transaction or hedging instrument before settlement.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/CNH offshore deliverable forwards (DF) contracted with licensed international banks
USD/CNY non-deliverable forwards (NDF) to hedge restricted onshore Renminbi exposure
USD/CNH vanilla FX options for adaptive hedging
USD/EUR cross-currency swaps to mitigate balance-sheet revaluation exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report (Corporate Annual Statement) and Annual Franchise Tax Payment
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Marshall Islands Maritime and Corporate Registry
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 60 days after the anniversary date of the filing of the Articles of Incorporation; the annual franchise tax is payable together with the Annual Report.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing incurs a penalty of US$200 or 10% of the unpaid franchise tax, whichever is greater; continued delinquency for more than 90 days may trigger administrative strike-off or dissolution, with reinstatement requiring payment of all arrears plus a US$500 reinstatement fee.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent and Registered Office Annual Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registered Agent in the Republic of the Marshall Islands (filed with the Registrar of Corporations where required)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the Annual Report, within 60 days after each anniversary of incorporation.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent and registered office in the Marshall Islands results in loss of good standing and may lead to administrative dissolution after notice from the Registrar.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory statutory audit is imposed on a non-resident Business Corporation under the Marshall Islands Business Corporations Act. An independent audit is required only if the corporation is listed, licensed as a bank, insurance carrier, fund administrator or other regulated entity, or if the shareholders by resolution or the Articles require an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS or US GAAP as voluntarily adopted by the board; the non-resident Business Corporation is not required to file financial statements with the Registrar for annual compliance purposes.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Under the Marshall Islands Registered Agents Act and Anti-Money Laundering regulations, the registered agent must maintain a confidential beneficial ownership file and annually confirm with the corporation that the registered member list and UBO records are accurate. Any share transfer, allotment, or beneficial ownership change occurring during the year must be recorded in the Register of Members and reported to the resident registered agent. There is no public UBO registry filing.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: US$4,000 - US$9,000 per annum for a voluntary independent audit; not required for the standard non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0% for a Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation; an otherwise taxable RMI entity may be subject to the 3% Gross Revenue Tax on RMI-source gross receipts.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Effective zero-rate on non-RMI-source income for a Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation; no corporate income tax on foreign-source revenue, no capital gains tax, no branch profits tax, no dividend withholding tax, and no payroll tax. The only mandatory periodic cost is the annual corporate franchise fee plus statutory filing fee; no tax holiday application is required because the exemption is statutory.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: No Marshall Islands corporate income tax return is prescribed for an exempt Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation. Annual corporate reporting is filed with the RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations through a licensed RMI resident agent and the online Registrar portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annually for the corporate annual report; no periodic CIT return or estimated CIT filing for the exempt BC.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The RMI annual corporate report is due in the anniversary month of incorporation; there is no tax return deadline because no CIT is imposed.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name, RMI registration number, date and jurisdiction of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Use the exact BC name as in the Certificate of Registration and state that the corporation is a Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and address of the licensed Marshall Islands resident agent and the physical RMI registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A P.O. Box alone is insufficient; the entity must maintain a current physical address through its resident agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full names, residential addresses, and identification details for each director and officer.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Nominee directors are permitted under the Business Corporations Act, but the BC's AML/CTF files must identify the natural persons with substantive control.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Number and par value of authorized shares; issued shares; class and series details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The RMI BC has no minimum capital requirement; state share premium or treasury share arrangements accurately.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the corporation has not derived gross revenue from RMI sources during the reporting period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If RMI-source gross revenue is earned, the 3% Gross Revenue Tax may apply and the BC should file the RMI Business License/Gross Revenue Tax return.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Franchise tax or annual corporate report fee payable to the Registrar.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Fee payment is typically processed by the resident agent; late payment triggers late filing penalties and potential administrative dissolution.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late annual report and fee filing attract a statutory late penalty; continued default for the statutory grace period may lead to administrative dissolution, loss of good standing, automatic termination of bank mandates, and inability to enforce contracts in RMI courts.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% (RMI does not impose withholding tax on dividends paid by a Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation; no branch remittance tax applies).
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: RMI has no comprehensive double taxation agreement network and no TRC application mechanism. The Compact of Free Association is not an income tax treaty. To evidence the zero-withholding status, the payor should maintain a certificate from the RMI Registered Agent/Registrar certifying non-resident status and the recipient's tax residence in the payee jurisdiction for foreign tax credit purposes.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory withholding rate 0% for both royalties and interest; no treaty rate is applicable because RMI has no income tax treaties. Payments of royalties for dried goji berry trademarks, herbal extraction formulas, or trade names and interest on intercompany debt by an exempt non-resident BC are not subject to RMI withholding tax.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory threshold (USD) is prescribed for an exempt non-resident BC; no Local File or Master File is required. If the BC unexpectedly becomes taxable under the RMI Gross Revenue Tax, contemporaneous pricing evidence must substantiate the arm's-length allocation of RMI-source gross receipts; no published de minimis threshold applies.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI Economic Substance (Implementation) Act imposes substance requirements on RMI tax-resident entities conducting 'relevant activities', including distribution and service centre activities. A dried goji berry wholesale exporter structured as an RMI BC cannot be a mere invoicing shell: if the entity is tax resident in RMI, it must demonstrate CIGA (core income generating activities) in RMI, adequate employees, physical premises, and routine board oversight. If the entity claims non-resident status, it must prove tax residence in another qualifying jurisdiction; otherwise the BC is exposed to economic substance penalties and strike-off.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion by Misuse of Exempt Non-Resident Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring non-resident status while the board of directors effectively manages RMI-based purchasing, inventory, or export decisions from an RMI office; issuing false dried goji berry invoices to shift revenue outside the RMI and avoid the 3% Gross Revenue Tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI civil tax fraud penalties of up to 50% of the underpaid tax plus interest; criminal liability for false statements under the RMI Criminal Code includes a fine and imprisonment for up to 5 years.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or approve false non-resident declarations and fraudulent invoices are jointly and severally liable for unpaid taxes; courts may pierce the corporate veil and issue restitution orders, travel bans, and criminal custodial sentences.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining the RMI BC solely as an invoicing and bank-account conduit for dried goji berry herbal exports, with no employees, no physical premises, no board minutes, no UBO records, and no bookkeeping in any jurisdiction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic substance penalties as prescribed by the RMI Economic Substance (Implementation) Act, including a base financial penalty, daily default penalties for continuing non-compliance, and mandatory disclosure/exchange of information with foreign tax authorities; the Registrar may strike off the entity.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are personally exposed to disqualification orders and pecuniary penalties; the corporate veil may be disregarded, making directors personally liable for creditors' losses, including unpaid trade suppliers of herbal commodity consignments.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Transfering dried goji berry stock, bank balances, supplier contracts, and distribution agreements to a newly created related BC at non-arm's-length values while leaving trade creditors and tax obligations behind; executing sham charges over inventory to defeat judgment creditors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI fraudulent conveyance and voidable preference rules allow court-ordered setting aside of the transfers and restoration of assets to the estate; criminal penalties apply for fraudulent disposition of property with intent to defraud creditors.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors are jointly and severally liable for the value of assets fraudulently conveyed; courts may issue worldwide asset freezing orders, seizure warrants, and travel bans, and may commit directors to imprisonment for contempt.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to maintain current beneficial ownership and customer due diligence files for dried goji berry buyers; accepting third-party payments from unrelated herbal trading companies; splitting Swift TT and wire transfers to avoid AML reporting thresholds; using the BC to obscure source-of-funds.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of the RMI Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act attract criminal fines, imprisonment, asset confiscation, and regulatory sanctions, including suspension or revocation of the BC's banking facility and corporate registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and AML officers are personally liable for wilful contraventions and may be fined, imprisoned, disqualified from managing corporations, and barred from international travel pending investigation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to file the annual corporate report and pay registration fees; resignation of the resident agent without replacement; continuation of export trading and bank transactions after the Registrar has administratively dissolved the BC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: The RMI Registrar may administratively dissolve the BC; after dissolution, corporate capacity and contracts are void or voidable, bank accounts are blocked, and reinstatement requires payment of all arrears, late penalties, and reinstatement fees.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who trade after administrative dissolution are personally liable for all debts incurred post-dissolution; the corporate veil is pierced as a matter of law, and affected counterparties may proceed directly against directors' personal assets.
